title: Unit-normalized ordinary proper and open arrows on strict towers
statement: Let $B$ be an arbitrary commutative ring. For schemes $X$ use the categories $\operatorname{Mod}(\underline B_X)$ on their small pro-etale sites, their strict inverse towers, inverse images $f^*$ and direct images $f_*$ [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], and open extensions $j_!$ with their specified adjunctions [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Use the invertible open unit, its direct-image transpose $j_!\to j_*$ (invertible for clopen $j$), and the clopen projection $\pi_s:\operatorname{id}\to s_!s^*$ already specified in [lem-cbc-proper-open-clopen-projector]. For a cartesian square with open horizontal arrows $j':U'\to X'$, $j:U\to X$, and vertical arrows $a:U'\to U$, $g:X'\to X$, use the specified inverse open-unit transpose $\beta:g^*j_!\to j'_!a^*$ and the unit-preserving composition isomorphisms $(kj)_!\cong k_!j_!$ from [lem-cbc-tower-open-beta-normalization], with no finiteness assumption on $B$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change] [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define transport of open extension along equality of morphisms by the unit-preserving left-adjoint conjugate of inverse-image transport. Given a commutative square $pk=ir$ with $k:V\to W$, $i:S\to T$ quasi-compact open immersions and $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], form $P=W\times_T S$, its projections $b:P\to W$, $q:P\to S$, and the canonical clopen lift $s:V\to P$ [def-pc-fibre-product] [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define the ordinary intrinsic $\alpha:p^*i_!\to k_!r^*$ by $\beta$ for the cartesian square, then $b_!\pi_sq^*$, and the specified inverse-image and open-extension compositors. Define its strict-tower version termwise. Exact localization of this termwise ordinary $\alpha$ equals the intrinsic derived $\alpha$ of [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows], with the exact-derived composition isomorphisms inserted. All adjunction mates use the specified adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]; no coefficient-finiteness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Compare the specified adjunction units after exact localization. The Hom equivalence converts the unit compatibility into compatibility with conjugate left-adjoint composition isomorphisms. Whiskering the ordinary open adjunction degreewise identifies the resulting ordinary compositor with openBetaModuleJComp. Equality transport reduces to the reflexive equality and the unit-preserving uniqueness isomorphism is the identity.

proof.text: Use openBetaNormalization for the cartesian beta factor. Use properOpen_clopen_geometry to obtain the complementary open to the canonical lift, and clopenDerived_section_projector for its localization equation. Naturality of the projector and of the open compositor pastes these representative equations with the pullback compositor. Each association isomorphism is the identity on components. The resulting composite is precisely the degreewise towerAlpha, proving ClopenProjectorDescent. The termwise lifting uses the generic composite-transformation wrapper; this has exactly the original components and keeps the large chosen module functors folded.
